issue_text:
Invoice totals are incorrect when orders include discounts, tax-exempt categories, or currencies with custom rounding precision.

Investigate the codebase and fix the invoice total calculation so that:
1. Per-line discounts are capped at the finance policy maximum and subtracted before computing subtotal and tax.
2. Tax-exempt product categories are excluded from taxable subtotal.
3. Subtotal, tax, and total are quantized according to the package currency and rounding policy.

Ensure all tests pass.
